verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Adyen's published OpenAPI definition files on GitHub. A user could load these into third-party tools to explore and run requests, but nothing shows a first-party interactive API reference with runnable examples, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec served from the docs domain. Missing for 10: a documented interactive API explorer, in-browser runnable examples, try-it-now request execution against a test environment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
